# Data

These datasets illustrate a district-level intervention in Texas using 832 simulated districts followed over 7 years. Every district is observed each year, so the panels are balanced. Each row represents one district in one year. Once a district starts treatment, it stays treated for the remaining years. For more details on the data-generation process, see our staggered DID simulation paper [link forthcoming].

## Treatment Effects

The treatment effects are shown below in standard-deviation (SD) units

| Dataset and group | Years 1-4 | Year 5 | Year 6 | Year 7 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Traditional DID treated group | 0 | 0.20 | 0.20 | 0.20 |
| Staggered DID early adopters | 0 | 0.10 | 0.20 | 0.30 |
| Staggered DID late adopters | 0 | 0 | 0.15 | 0.25 |
| Never-treated groups | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Codebook

| Variable | Definition |
|---|---|
| `district_id` | District identifier from 1 to 832 |
| `year` | Study year from 1 to 7 |
| `treatment_start_year` | First treated year, with 0 for never treated |
| `outcome_std` | Achievement in SD units, standardized across districts and years before treatment effects are added |

We create the treatment indicators during the lab using `treatment_start_year` and `year`.
